placements.link_name: Hydrometallurgical polymetallic nodule processing and refining technology
placements.role: Holds the exclusive nodule resource and is the counterparty that commissions and funds both proven routes toward separated nickel/copper/cobalt/manganese product: the PAMCO calcine retrofit in Japan, and, since a March 2026 Strategic Partnership Agreement and a July 2026 Master Services Agreement, dedicated new hydrometallurgical processing and refining capacity with Mariana Minerals at the Port of Brownsville. TMC's own capital and offtake rights are what actually flow through this processing stage.

role_evidence.claim: On March 19, 2026, we signed a Strategic Partnership Agreement with Mariana focusing on the potential development of a nodule processing and refining facility in the Port of Brownsville, Texas as part of our owner's team.
role_evidence.source_name: TMC the Metals Co Inc, Form 10-K for fiscal year 2025
role_evidence.source_excerpt: On March 19, 2026, we signed a Strategic Partnership Agreement with Mariana focusing on the potential development of a nodule processing and refining facility in the Port of Brownsville, Texas as part of our owner's team.

placements.link_name: Clarion-Clipperton Zone nodule resource and exploration and recovery rights
placements.role: TMC USA's newly filed USA-A consolidated application covers a ~65,000 km2 exploration and commercial recovery area in the Clarion-Clipperton Zone with an estimated resource of 619 Mt of wet nodules (plus up to 200 Mt of exploration upside), the raw physical and legal input this chain's downstream links depend on.
placements.secondary_link_basis: Second placement for the same issuer on a distinct link (resource rights vs. downstream processing); TMC is both the resource holder and the funding counterparty for refining capacity.
